rows.desktop_responsibility: Server-side D1 schema for durable Remote Computer mobile control-session create identity, lost-response reconciliation, credential-generation fencing, and same-request uniqueness (RCS-01..07).
rows.desktop_visible_effect: A paired mobile API client can recover the same server control session after an ambiguous create outcome without persisting a raw mobile control token.
rows.ios_platform_delta: Current native iOS Remote Computer shipping does not create or reconcile /v1/computers/:device_id/sessions and has no clientId/clientToken/mobileToken/requestId durable owner. It uses IOSPreloadBridge -> IOSMainRuntime -> MahayanaCoordinator -> canonical Host for lifecycle RPCs plus a restricted official Remote Computer WebView/VNC. FabushiRemoteDeviceGateway is a separate account-access-token semantic gateway and is not a Remote Computer control credential or Runner bearer.
rows.production_evidence: PR HEAD 594e1d17 production call-graph audit: RemoteComputerSurface has no native control-session create/reconcile call; IOSPreloadBridge forwards typed Coordinator requests; IOSMainRuntime routes to MahayanaCoordinator/canonical Host; FabushiRemoteDeviceGateway uses AgentSession.accessToken for its separate semantic gateway.
rows.test_evidence: RCS server contract tests live upstream in Desktop mahayana-platform-worker. Descendant iOS exact-head architecture/protected-session Actions remain required for the replacement composition.
rows.notes: N/A-with-replacement is based on the actual iOS shipping call graph, not solely on the upstream Android-compatibility wording. Aggregate dependency/shared-contract review remains pending.
